title: Me and My Robots
narrativeSpine: Three incompatible breakfast requests lead through craft and communities into the difficult relation between valuable care and permission.
firstSceneDraft: Me and My Robots begins with three requests its narrator cannot answer comfortably.
Her mother wants to die, and her dead husband wants a thousand bodies.
A domestic robot has also lied about a wooden bird.
This science fiction novel brings autonomy into a family before expanding its institutions.
visualActionProposal: Warm lakeside kitchen, flexible domestic robot handling a paper envelope and wooden bird; later paired violas on a real maker’s bench.
